# arin_nets_by_ip_range (Data Source)

List network registrations for an IP address range. This is an authenticated Reg-RWS lookup, distinct from public organization discovery.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
# Set ARIN_API_KEY in the environment.
data "arin_nets_by_ip_range" "example" {
  start_address = "192.0.2.0"
  end_address   = "192.0.2.255"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end_address` (String) Last address of the IP range, in the same address family.
- `start_address` (String) First address of the IP range.

### Read-Only

- `networks` (Attributes List) Records returned by ARIN, ordered deterministically. An empty collection is an empty list; authorization and missing-object errors remain errors. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))
